subject: Culture
title: The First Haircut
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The First Haircut.

hook.text: In Hindu tradition, a baby's first haircut is a sacred event. The hair is offered at a temple.

buildup.text: The mundan ceremony shaves the child's head completely. It symbolizes removing past-life karma.

discovery.text: Jewish upsherin waits until a boy turns three. His first haircut marks the start of Torah study.

twist.text: In Mongolia, a first haircut is a community event. Guests take turns cutting a lock and giving a gift.

climax.text: Hair is just protein. But the act of cutting it becomes a doorway between two states of being.

punchline.text: A haircut can carry the weight of a new life.

quiz.question: What does the Hindu mundan ceremony symbolize?
